radar.title: Radar
radar.loadErrorDescription: The device didn't answer. Check that it's on and on the same network, then try again.
radar.noLocationDescription: Set the location the radar watches, and it starts showing the aircraft flying around it.

status.waitingForNetwork: Waiting for the Wi-Fi to download the flights.
status.clear: Clear sky: no aircraft within {range} right now.
status.stale: The flight data is {minutes} min old: the radar keeps trying.
status.error: The flight data couldn't be downloaded yet: the radar keeps trying.

radar.problemDescription: The radar can't download the flight data right now. It retries by itself.
radar.offlineDescription: The aircraft on screen may be old. Check that the device is on and on the same network.
radar.listHint: Nearest first. The faded ones are just outside the range, shown on the edge of the display. Data from adsb.fi.

details.gone: This aircraft has left the radar.

settings.title: Settings
settings.loadErrorDescription: The device didn't answer. Check that it's on and on the same network, then try again.

location.title: Location
location.hint: The center of the radar, as latitude and longitude. In Google Maps, right-click your place and click the numbers to copy them, then paste them here.
location.coordinatesInvalid: Enter the latitude and the longitude separated by a comma, for example 45.46420, 9.19000.
location.name: Name
location.nameTooLong: The name of the location is too long (up to 24 characters).

settings.radarHint: The range is the radius of the outer ring. Aircraft just outside it show as marks on the edge.

range.label: Range
range.note: How far the radar looks around its location.
range.hint5: Your neighborhood: low flights and helicopters
range.hint40: The default: a busy slice of sky
range.hint150: Everything around: crowded near big airports

units.label: Units
units.aviationMeta: Nautical miles, feet, flight levels and knots

settings.displayHint: Changes show on the display as soon as you save.

theme.label: Theme
theme.phosphorMeta: Green, like an old radar tube
theme.amberMeta: Warm orange, like an amber screen
theme.arcticMeta: Cyan and white on deep blue

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.note: Turn the picture to match how the display sits in its case.

settings.saveSuccess: The radar is using the new settings.
settings.saveError: An error occurred while saving the settings

device.resetConfirmMessage: The radar will forget its location, its settings and its Wi-Fi network, then restart into its setup hotspot.
device.resetInfoMessage: The radar forgot its settings and is restarting into its setup hotspot. Join the hotspot to set it up again.
device.resetError: An error occurred while resetting the settings
